stateNativeTurnoutAndDenominator.parserNeeded: Turnout dashboard/export normalizer that records precinct ballots cast and eligible-voter denominator fields, then reconciles to the active EAC fallback. Active ND ETL still uses EAC turnout rows.
stateNativeTurnoutAndDenominator.caveat: North Dakota does not require voter registration. The active EAC registered-voter denominator is zero by source semantics, so turnout displays must use an eligible-voter or state-native denominator caveat rather than treating registered voters as simply missing.
